definitions.explanation: A formal way for employees to refer to their own company, typical of speeches, internal messages and company writing.

examples.japanese: {我|わ}が{社|しゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{強|つよ}み→強み：12499_tsuyomi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{技術力|ぎじゅつりょく}だ。
examples.english: Our company's strength is its technology.

examples.japanese: {我|わ}が{社|しゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦{創業|そうぎょう}→創業：11792_sougyou⟧{五十周年|ごじっしゅうねん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: Our company marks its fiftieth anniversary this year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年頭|ねんとう}→年頭：21721_nentou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{我|わ}が{社|しゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧べき⟦{方向|ほうこう}→方向：03617_houkou⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{語|かた}った→語る：01930_kataru⟧。
examples.english: In the New Year address, the president spoke about the direction our company should take.

notes:
⟦{我|わ}が→我が〜：03971_waga⟧ is a formal possessive, 'our, my', as in ⟦{我|わ}が{国|くに}→我が国：13449_wagakuni⟧ (our country) and ⟦{我|わ}が{家|や}→我が家：03038_wagaya⟧ (our home).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{弊社|へいしゃ}→弊社：17404_heisha⟧: our company (humble; used to customers and other companies)
- ⟦{当社|とうしゃ}→当社：22449_tousha⟧: this company (formal; official statements and documents)
- ⟦{自社|じしゃ}→自社：14070_jisha⟧: one's own company (as a modifier: ⟦{自社|じしゃ}→自社：14070_jisha⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧)
- うち: our company (casual)

WATCH OUT:
{我|わ}が{社|しゃ} speaks from inside the company; when addressing a client, use ⟦{弊社|へいしゃ}→弊社：17404_heisha⟧.
